hotspots.label: Mourners
hotspots.note: Two mourners with arms raised: the lament at the head of the procession.

hotspots.label: Women mourners
hotspots.note: Six women walk with hands to their faces.

hotspots.label: Canopy frame
hotspots.note: An empty canopy frame carried in the procession.

hotspots.label: Anubis on a chest
hotspots.note: Anubis as a jackal on a chest, dragged on a sledge. You will meet him again at the judgment.

hotspots.label: Boat-sledge
hotspots.note: A boat on a sledge with figures aboard.

hotspots.label: The mummy on its sledge
hotspots.note: The mummy lies in a shrine on a boat-shaped sledge. It must be hauled to the tomb.

hotspots.label: Priest with censer
hotspots.note: A priest offers incense before the mummy.

hotspots.label: Hauler
hotspots.note: A man hauls the sledge rope.

hotspots.label: Ox-driver
hotspots.note: A man with a stick drives the ox that pulls the sledge.

hotspots.label: Plumed ox
hotspots.note: An ox crowned with plumes, led toward the sacrifice.

hotspots.label: Canopy-bearer
hotspots.note: A man walks under a portable canopy.

hotspots.label: Yoke-bearer
hotspots.note: A man carries two vessels on a shoulder yoke.

hotspots.label: Two women
hotspots.note: Two women walk in the procession.

hotspots.label: The sacrifice
hotspots.note: A bull is thrown down and its foreleg cut, for the Opening of the Mouth.

hotspots.label: Lector priest
hotspots.note: The lector priest reads from a scroll.

hotspots.label: Offering table
hotspots.note: A great heaped table of bread, meat, fowl and fruit, between pairs of trees.

hotspots.label: Offerer
hotspots.note: A kneeling man raises an offering toward the table.
